blocks.en: Scanning is the primary method of finding objects and locations in space.
blocks.zh: 扫描是在太空中寻找物体和地点的主要手段。

blocks.en: This table shows the type of scanning you will most likely use when looking for a specific result.
blocks.zh: 下表列出了寻找特定目标时最常用的扫描方式。

en: Names of objects within 14AU of your ship
zh: 你的舰船 14AU 范围内物体的名称

blocks.en: Follow the links below for more detailed information.
blocks.zh: 更详细的内容请见下面的链接。

blocks.en: Every ship in EVE comes with an onboard Overview window that can be configured to show planets, asteroid belts, moons, stations, and other useful objects in the current system. A thorough study of the Overview is highly recommended because it is difficult to play EVE without this information. Every ship in EVE also comes with an onboard Directional Scanner (D-scan) that can be used to discover, but not pinpoint via distance or coordinates, objects up to 14 AU away from the ship.
blocks.zh: EVE 中的每艘舰船都自带总览（Overview）窗口，可以设置显示当前星系中的行星、小行星带、卫星、空间站以及其它有用的物体。强烈建议好好研究一下总览，因为没有这些信息，EVE 几乎没法玩。每艘舰船也都自带定向扫描（D-Scan），可以发现距离舰船 14 AU 以内的物体，但无法通过距离或坐标精确定位它们。

blocks.en: This equipment can be used to search for Cosmic Anomalies (including ice belts and gas clouds) and other objects not found on the Overview.
blocks.zh: 这套设备可以用来搜索宇宙异常（包括冰矿带和气云）以及其它不会出现在总览上的物体。

blocks.en: In addition, each ship has a Solar System Map that displays the overview and directional scanning data in graphic form.
blocks.zh: 此外，每艘舰船都有星系地图，以图形方式显示总览和定向扫描的数据。

blocks.en: Asteroid and ice miners may use survey scanners to measure distances to various targets and monitor their volume as they are mined. Survey scanners typically measure resource type, quantity and distance. They have a maximum range of 15 km (23 km with T2), and they occupy a mid-level fitting slot.
blocks.zh: 采矿和采冰的玩家可以使用测量扫描器来测量与各个目标的距离，并在开采过程中监控其剩余储量。测量扫描器通常能测出资源种类、数量和距离。它的最大范围为 15 km（T2 为 23 km），占用一个中槽。

blocks.en: While the range of a scanner is small, the scanned asteroids stay in the menu if the scanner is run again at a different point within the same grid. Therefore, it is possible to get the contents of the entire belt/anomaly by scanning it multiple times at different spots without closing the survey scanner window.
blocks.zh: 虽然扫描器的范围很小，但如果在同一网格内的不同位置再次扫描，之前扫到的小行星会保留在列表里。因此，只要不关闭测量扫描器窗口，在不同位置多扫几次，就能得到整个矿带 / 异常的全部内容。

blocks.en: Every ship in EVE except for shuttles and freighters can fit a Scan Probe Launcher module. These launch probes that increase the number of types of objects that can be detected and the range at which they can be scanned. Such probes provide distance and coordinate information. A probe launcher will take up a high fitting slot.
blocks.zh: 除穿梭机和货舰外，EVE 中的所有舰船都可以装配扫描探针发射器。它发射的探针能扩大可探测物体的种类和扫描范围，并提供距离和坐标信息。探针发射器占用一个高槽。

blocks.en: A probe launcher can launch various types of probes:
blocks.zh: 探针发射器可以发射多种探针：

en: "Scan" probes are used extensively in Exploration to find wormholes and other Cosmic Anomalies. They are also used to find PvE combat sites and other cosmic signatures.
"Combat" probes can pinpoint the location of other ships. These are most frequently used in PvP.

Moon mining uses specialized survey probes which investigate a solar system and return the ore name, the quantity, the TypeID, and the ID's for the Solar System, Planet and Moon. (Note that these are probes and must be launched - as opposed to the use of a survey scanner as described above.)
zh: “扫描”探针在探索中大量使用，用来寻找虫洞和其它宇宙异常，也用来寻找 PvE 战斗站点和其它宇宙信号。
“作战”探针可以精确定位其它舰船，最常用于 PvP。
卫星采矿使用专门的测量探针，它会勘察整个星系，并返回矿石名称、数量、TypeID，以及星系、行星和卫星的 ID。（注意这些是探针，必须发射出去，这与上文所说的测量扫描器不同。）
